title: Recovery of valuable metals from lithium-containing aluminum electrolyte slag via an NaOH leaching-aging-water leaching process
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,3080-3087
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00210A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ting Zhou, Chenyu Zhang, Rui Xu, Sha Luo, Wenzhang Li, Yang Liu
A “sodium hydroxide leaching-aging-water leaching” process was employed for recovering lithium, aluminum, and fluoride from aluminum electrolyte slag, and NaF, AlOOH, and Li2CO3 were obtained as products.
